mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, which may increase clobazam and its active metabolite N-desmethylclobazam plasma concentrations.
action: Monitor for increased clobazam side effects (sedation, ataxia, dizziness); consider clobazam dose reduction if systemic clotrimazole use is prolonged or at high doses.
